title: Middle Monitor webhook payload
description:
Body posted to a notification channel of type webhook configured with format: structured. A channel left on the default format receives the Slack-compatible shape instead, which this schema does not describe.

Signature: the request carries X-Middmonitor-Timestamp (unix seconds) and X-Middmonitor-Signature-256, which is 'sha256=' followed by the hex HMAC-SHA256, keyed with the channel secret, of the exact bytes '<timestamp>.<raw body>'. Reject a request whose timestamp is outside your tolerance window to refuse replays. The legacy X-Middmonitor-Signature header is the HMAC of the raw body alone and is kept for receivers written against it.

version.description: Payload shape version. A breaking change increments it.

event_id.description: Unique per delivery attempt group. A redelivery of the same event keeps it.

dedup_key.description: Stable across every event about the same underlying problem. Send it back to PUT /incidents/dedup/{key}/status to acknowledge or resolve without storing ids.

threshold.description: The threshold that was crossed, at the severity of this incident.

labels.description: Label constraints of the rule when it watches a custom metric, plus 'actor' when a machine requested the transition.

grouped.description: Present when the channel configured group_by: this delivery covers a burst.

count.description: Total events in the burst, including this one.

events.description: The other events of the burst.
